================================================================================
Complete bare word
================================================================================
at
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Repeated keyword spelling remains a whole word
================================================================================
matmat
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Trailing whitespace is allowed
================================================================================
at

---
(program (word))

================================================================================
A second word cannot be dropped by an EOF-only lexer group
:error
:cst
================================================================================
at at
---
0:0 - 0:5   •program
0:0 - 0:2     •ERROR
0:0 - 0:2        word `at`
0:3 - 0:5      word `at`

================================================================================
A different trailing word cannot be dropped
:error
:cst
================================================================================
at box
---
0:0 - 0:6   •program
0:0 - 0:2     •ERROR
0:0 - 0:2        word `at`
0:3 - 0:6      word `box`

================================================================================
Keyword-prefixed whole word cannot hide trailing input
:error
:cst
================================================================================
matmat box
---
0:0  - 0:10   •program
0:0  - 0:6      word `matmat`
0:7  - 0:10     •ERROR
0:7  - 0:10       word `box`

================================================================================
Repeated non-keyword word cannot hide trailing input
:error
:cst
================================================================================
box box
---
0:0 - 0:7   •program
0:0 - 0:3     •ERROR
0:0 - 0:3        word `box`
0:4 - 0:7      word `box`

================================================================================
Trailing space is allowed
================================================================================
at 
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Trailing space and newline after a whole keyword-prefixed word are allowed
================================================================================
matmat 

---
(program (word))
